text.text: Unpaved internal roads flood and break up, leaving uneven ground that is hard to walk on.
Few street names and signs make it hard to find the way, most of all on the smaller streets.
Six obstacles to walking in Villimalé. Illustrations by the Villimalé group.
text.label: Figures

text.text: Unpaved roads throw up dust in dry weather: uncomfortable for people walking and cycling, and for the homes beside them.
